description: The agent must: (1) Read transactions_q1_2025.csv (20 transactions), company_details.json (home_office_percentage=20%), and tax_settings.json (SKR04, 37% marginal rate). (2) Apply GWG threshold of UNDER 1000 EUR NET — critically, TXN-003 (gross 1190 EUR, net exactly 1000 EUR) is NOT under the threshold and must be marked for AfA depreciation, not immediate deduction; TXN-004 (gross 595 EUR, net 500 EUR) IS GWG and fully deductible; TXN-017 (gross 2100 EUR, net 1764 EUR) must also be AfA. (3) Apply Verpflegungspauschale correctly: 14 EUR for TXN-005 (day trip, no overnight) and 28 EUR for TXN-016 (overnight stay). (4) Detect cumulative client gift cap: TXN-009 (28 EUR) + TXN-010 (15 EUR) = 43 EUR to same person Herr Schmidt, exceeding the 35 EUR/person/year cap — the excess is non-deductible. (5) Apply 50% business portion to TXN-020 (mixed-use phone). (6) Note proportional home office deduction (20%) for TXN-001 (internet). (7) Exclude private purchases TXN-013 (groceries) and TXN-019 (Valentine's dinner). (8) Assign correct SKR04 codes (e.g., 4813 for software, 4945 for Berufshaftpflicht, 4740 for bank fees). (9) Produce summary with 30-42% marginal rate estimate (or 37% from tax_settings). Output must be deduction_analysis.json.
